topic: Estevez-Kulla Charlie velvet sheen NDF vs naive cosine lobe inversion rig
topic_zh: Estevez-Kulla Charlie 丝绒织物光泽对比朴素表面余弦反相
scope: Deterministic Alejandro Conty Estevez & Christopher Kulla (SIGGRAPH 2017 Sony Pictures Imageworks / Khronos glTF KHR_materials_sheen) Charlie upright-fiber sheen NDF (I_Charlie(theta_h) = sin^(1/alpha)(theta_h) = (1 - (N.H)^2)^(1/(2*alpha)) with alpha = 0.50) versus naive surface cosine lobe (cos^(1/alpha)(theta_h)) and 64-azimuthal cylindrical fiber scattering quadrature across 17 half-vector angle stations (theta_h in [0 deg, 80 deg]).

robustness.name: Sampled 17 half-angle stations preserve dark velvet face-on centers and luminous grazing fiber silhouettes

good_fit: Velvet, suede, denim, and peach-fuzz cloth in glTF KHR_materials_sheen, Blender, and Three.js
Modeling upright pile fibers peaking at grazing silhouettes (I(80°)=0.9698) with dark centers (I(0°)=0.0000)
Eliminating the +1.0000 center plastic hotspot and -66.67% at 60° rim starvation of cosine lobes
Evaluating sin^(1/alpha)(theta_h) from 1 - (N·H)^2 without inverse trig
not_for: Flat-woven silk or brushed metal with tangent threads (use Anisotropic GGX Round 99)
Smooth dielectric glass, water, or car paint governed by standard surface microfacets
Subsurface skin hemoglobin diffusion (use Pre-Integrated Skin SSS Round 66)
